6-bedroom Detached family home
Guide: €425,000
Michael Dorgan Auctioneers & Valuers are delighted to present new to the market, this well maintained 6-bedroom property, offers bright spacious living accommodation, a superb location within walking distance of Kildorrery Village.  A short commute from Cork, Limerick and surrounding major towns.
Viewing strictly by appointment.




Location:
Located just off of Kildorrery/ Mallow Rd, a stones throw from amenities, 10 minutes from Mitchelstown, 15 minutes from Fermoy & Mallow. Unrivalled access to the M8 motorway at Junction 14 (10 minutes), with the property just over 40minutes from the Jack Lynch Tunnel. Despite such convenience the property benefits greatly from the areas. scenic countryside & a vibrant community.

Superb location.
South facing garden.
Outside is set out in Lawn/Concrete/Gravel.
Water feature & patio.
Mains Water & Septic tank.
Oil fired central heating system. New boiler.
PVC double glazed windows. Slate roof.
Detached Garage with potential.
11.5km from The M8 Motorway.
40minutes from the Jack Lynch Tunnel.
